details.story: As a user, I want the system to automatically delete or archive data that exceeds its configured TTL, so that storage is reclaimed according to policy.

details.story: As an app developer, I want to declare dataset type dependencies in the app specification, so that the platform can resolve and provision them consistently.

details.story: As a pipeline designer, I want to choose whether dataset instances created by a pipeline are deleted when the pipeline is deleted, so that orphan datasets do not remain.

details.story: As a user, I want to view lineage for a dataset instance, so that I can see which apps, pipelines, or plugins created or consumed it.

details.story: As a developer, I want to view metrics for a dataset instance, such as storage size and access counts, so that I can monitor usage and capacity.

details.story: As a developer, I want to back up a dataset instance and restore it later, so that I can recover from data loss or corruption.

details.story: As a user, I want to transfer ownership of a dataset instance to another user or application, so that responsibility can change without recreating it.

details.story: As a dataset developer, I want to mark a dataset type version as deprecated, so that users are warned not to create new dataset instances with it.

details.story: As a user, I want schema strings to be validated for syntax and support by the dataset type at creation time, so that invalid schema configurations fail early.

details.story: As a data scientist, I want to query an explored dataset using SQL, so that I can analyze the data without writing code.

details.story: As a user, I want to rate discovered content items, so that the recommendation engine can learn my preferences.
details.reason: Profile-based and similar-user recommendations imply a need for explicit feedback to improve results.

details.story: As a user, I want to save discovered content into personal playlists, so that I can access it later from one place.
details.reason: Search and discovery features are present but there is no way to persist or organize results.

details.story: As a user, I want to filter search results by tags and metadata, so that I can narrow down large result sets.
details.reason: Uploaded videos have tags available for processing, but no user-facing filtering by those tags is specified.

details.story: As a user, I want to receive notifications when new content matches my profile or interests, so that I can discover it promptly.
details.reason: Profile-based discovery exists but lacks proactive alerting.

details.story: As a user, I want to share discovered content with other users, so that I can discuss or recommend items.
details.reason: Similar-user discovery exists but direct sharing between users is not covered.

details.story: As a user, I want to view the automatically generated transcript for a video, so that I can understand its spoken content.
details.reason: ASR is used for content search but transcript display is not mentioned.

details.story: As an admin, I want to monitor the status of content ingestion and analysis jobs, so that I can detect and resolve processing failures.
details.reason: Many automated processing steps exist, but operational monitoring is not specified.

details.story: As an admin, I want to review and moderate user-supplied tags on uploaded videos, so that inaccurate or inappropriate tags are removed.
details.reason: User tags are ingested but there is no quality control step for the tags themselves.

details.story: As an admin, I want to review and confirm automated copyright infringement detections, so that false positives can be resolved before action is taken.
details.reason: Automated copyright validation exists but manual review and confirmation is likely needed.

details.story: As an admin, I want to prefilter violent or graphic content, so that it can be handled according to safety and policy requirements.
details.reason: Nudity prefiltering is specified, suggesting other sensitive content classes are also needed.

details.story: As an admin, I want to visualize which parts of an audio file may have been edited, so that I can inspect suspicious segments quickly.
details.reason: The system assesses edited audio, but admins need a way to review the evidence.

details.story: As an admin, I want to search content by recognized entities such as persons, products, brands, or logos, so that I can locate items for moderation or metadata enrichment.
details.reason: Entity identification exists for users, but admin search by those entities is not mentioned.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to aggregate multiple volunteer classifications into a consensus label, so that I can produce reliable final annotations.
details.reason: Several preclassification and volunteer classification features exist but no consensus aggregation is specified.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to compare volunteer classifications against expert gold-standard examples, so that I can measure volunteer accuracy.
details.reason: Volunteer types and experience weighting exist, but accuracy against ground truth is not covered.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect disagreement among volunteer classifications for a subject, so that ambiguous cases can be flagged for expert review.
details.reason: Consensus aggregation and volunteer weighting imply a need to handle conflict.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assign tasks to volunteers based on their skills and experience, so that each task is completed by the most suitable volunteer.
details.reason: Volunteer types and project recommendations exist, but task-level routing is not specified.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect when a volunteer is struggling or confused during classification, so that I can offer timely help.
details.reason: Interruption and education timing exist, but the trigger condition of confusion is not explicitly covered.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically generate educational content from common volunteer mistakes, so that volunteers can learn from real examples.
details.reason: Education delivery is covered, but content creation is not.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to summarize discussions on Talk, so that I can quickly understand volunteer feedback and issues.
details.reason: Interesting comment detection exists, but discussion summarization is missing.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect rare or anomalous sightings in citizen science images, so that scientists can investigate unusual events.
details.reason: Several detectors look for specific known classes, but rare or anomalous event detection is not covered.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to train classification models using aggregated volunteer annotations, so that automated preclassification improves over time.
details.reason: Many preclassification features exist, but a feedback loop from volunteer labels is not specified.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to display automated preclassification results to volunteers as suggested labels, so that they can validate or correct them.
details.reason: Automated preclassification exists but its use in the volunteer workflow is not covered.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to export aggregated annotations and analysis results, so that researchers can use them in scientific studies.
details.reason: Many automatic analyses are performed, but no data export capability is mentioned.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when a volunteer has completed a classification task or session, so that I can provide appropriate feedback or next steps.
details.reason: Interruption, education, and project recommendation exist, but session completion detection is missing.
